_README: Spoken Mongolian for every numeric token that appears in a stop name.
Chimege accepts Cyrillic letters, spaces and ? ! . - ' " : , ONLY. Digits are
rejected outright (HTTP 400), so 895 of 923 stop names cannot be sent as-is.
This table is the stop-name equivalent of routes' spokenName: display text and
spoken text are different things and must never share a value.
STATUS: DRAFT — needs review by a native speaker before shipping.
The grammar here is mechanical (ordinal -дугаар/-дүгээр by vowel harmony,
genitive -ын/-ийн, attributive forms before nouns) and the clip DURATIONS are
right, so size measurements built on it hold. The wording is what needs eyes.
Keys are matched longest-first against the display name, so compound tokens
like '7 буудал' win over the bare '7'. Any token with no entry fails the
build and is written to speech.todo.json — it never falls back to digits.
_compounds: number + noun — attributive form of the numeral
_cardinals: bare N — trailing label, e.g. 'Их наран 1'
_latin: Latin letters are rejected too — spelled out Mongolian-style
